recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core FHIR work is needed for FHIR-45349; future search-parameter naming or prefix policy changes should be handled by focused tickets.
issue_request: FHIR-45349 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 change request to prohibit '.', '$', and '|' in SearchParameter.code because those characters are used as search-processing separators; the Jira description also suggested prohibiting whitespace.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit d5f07239ce65aaf9b19fe17ede1e66aa10ba960f, included in merged PR HL7/fhir#3967, which added SearchParameter spd-4 and spd-5 constraints and attached them to code and aliasCode.
additional_context: SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini. The originating Zulip thread confirmed that period characters interfere with search syntax such as chaining, and FHIR-I minutes on 2024-05-13 record the Persuasive 9-0-0 vote. Broader search-parameter naming tickets such as FHIR-3855 and FHIR-37590 are related background but do not change this separator-specific conclusion.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The combined branch already contains the implementation commit and the current StructureDefinition has machine-readable constraints prohibiting the requested separator characters and whitespace.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue established lowercase dash-separated search-parameter naming guidance and has already been audited on the combined branch.
Earlier Published issue concerns custom search parameters with '-' prefixes and the SearchParameter.name/code distinction; it is separate from prohibiting '.', '$', '|', and whitespace.
